name: Akamimi
source:
Red is Tokio Morishima's beloved pet turtle. According to Tokio he is a male red slider. Red spends most of his time in his tank [Spoiler]or in the bathtub of Tokio's boat when the pair move to Ward 25.[/spoiler] Sometime between 1999 and 2005, Red seems to have grown quite a lot in size. 

[Based on the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Red]Wiki[/url] description]
